title: If you need reminders for your tasks … stay away from the app
body:
An import feature is to set a reminder, if you set a reminder you need to set a time manually. The default time for the reminder is the current time… why on earth would I need a reminder at the moment I am writing the task. There should be an option the set a reminder with quick buttons as well. so in summary .. the whole reminder function is simply too time consuming to use and therefore useless
If you don’t need reminders for your tasks.. it’s a good app… otherwise stay away from it 

Developers refuse to implement it .. most likely they don’t know how to do it …. 

I don’t think the developer uses the app himself otherwise he would have found out already
